objections.quote: What's the making charge on this?

coaching_tip: When the customer asks how the making charge is worked out, give the percentage and split the total into gold, making and GST, because he asked for it at 00:43 and again at 01:06.
flags: hallmark question at 01:06 read as a confirmation check, not a purity_trust objection
handling scored 2 for vague making-charge answers at 00:38 and 00:48, although the sale closed

customer.intent_evidence: 00:07 asked for a 15-30 g chain for his brother's wedding next month

key_moments.what: showed two chains within the asked 15-30 g range
liked the rope design and asked to try it
deflected the making-charge question with 'everyone pays the same'
agreed to buy the rope chain

missed_opportunities.what: no making percentage or per-gram rate stated when asked
no breakup of gold, making and GST with the total
no add-on suggested for the wedding after 'one thing off my list'

price_talk.notes: only the GST-inclusive total was given at 00:59
